title: compact init stages and values validation for on-prem installer
author: Isabel Ramos
body:
Motivation: Private/on-prem installs continue to surface flaky init sequencing and unclear values validation that lead to mid-upgrade failures. This PR compacts the init pipeline into three deterministic stages, centralizes values schema validation, and introduces a lightweight preflight probe to fail fast on common misconfiguration (networking, missing secrets, wrong CIDR). Changes here are focused on the Helm chart surface for the private installer and companion examples used by the terraform module.

Summary of changes: compact init pipeline (prepare -> connect -> finalise), strict values schema (OpenAPI-style JSONSchema for top-level values), templating helpers to reduce repeated conditionals, idempotent init-job wrappers, and a preflight hook that runs as a short-lived Job with clear diagnostics. Also adds example values for VPC and airgapped installs and documents required KMS/secret keys.

Migration notes: Charts that previously relied on per-component init hooks should move to the new three-stage lifecycle. Automatic mapping helpers are provided, but operators must verify custom hooks that assumed previous ordering. Values keys deprecated: init.oldSequence -> init.stages (migrator prints a warning). No automatic secret rotation is performed by this PR.

Implementation details: - values.schema.yaml: a concise JSONSchema that validates top-level keys (network, storage, init, secrets, upgrade). The schema intentionally keeps model-specific tuning out of the chart to avoid frequent churn. - templates/_init-helpers.tpl: helper templates for stage gating, backoff annotations, and leader-elector hints. - templates/init-job-compact.yaml: produces a single Job per stage with annotated fence ConfigMap to prevent overlapping runs. Jobs are idempotent and use a consistent checkpoint path in the tenant PVC. - templates/preflight-job.yaml: short Job that verifies DNS resolvability, KMS access (optional), and cluster resource requests; returns structured diagnostics in a pod log artifact stored on completion. - values/examples/*: added vpc-example.yaml and airgap-example.yaml with minimal required fields and notes.

Testing and rollout: Ran integration deploys in our internal staging environment across three topologies (single-tenant VPC, multi-az VPC, airgapped on-prem VM). Smoke tests for install/upgrade/rollback paths passed. CI: lint/chart tests + unit schema validation + e2e smoke job. Canary rollout plan: merge to release branch, cut a candidate bundle consumed by the private-installer job, and run tenant-scoped dryruns for 5 customers before wide rollout.

Checklist: - [x] values schema added and covered by unit tests - [x] init templates refactored and idempotency addressed - [x] preflight probe implemented - [x] updated examples and docs - [x] integration smoke runs in staging

Related work: this complements ENG-1171 (hook reconciliation improvements) and the private-installer terraform module updates in ENG-1304.
commits: 7e9a1c4: add values.schema.yaml and unit schema validator
b3f2d2a: refactor init into compact stages and add helper template
d5c3f9e: implement preflight job and example values for VPC/airgap
a8c77b1: add migration warnings for deprecated init.oldSequence
f12e4bb: update README with preflight expectations and rollout notes
review_comments: Evan Park: Nice consolidation. Two asks: (1) prove the fence ConfigMap is safe under concurrent upgrades, (2) can we keep the preflight probe optional via a values toggle?
Isabel Ramos: Addressed: fence now uses annotation-based mutex with exponential backoff; preflight job enabled by default but controlled by values.preflight.enabled. Added docs and tests.
Maya Kaur: The JSONSchema looks strict — raise a migration warning rather than failing older installs. Also suggest a clear example for KMS optional path.
Isabel Ramos: Migration warning added. Wrote vpc-example and airgap-example clarifying KMS vs secret-file flows.
Liam O'Connor: CI flake on e2e fixed — increased timeout for PVC bind in airgap test. Approving.
Release Engineer (automated): please include release notes entry; otherwise staging will block.
merge_commit_summary: squash: compact init stages + values schema + preflight job
release_notes: Improvements to private installer: consolidated init pipeline (prepare/connect/finalise), added top-level values schema validation, preflight probe for misconfiguration detection, and new example values for VPC/airgapped installs. Operators should review migration warnings for init.oldSequence deprecation.
notes_for_ops: Operators: if you maintain custom init hooks, verify they either opt into the new stages via hooks.stage or are migrated to run as sidecar init containers. To disable preflight: set preflight.enabled=false. For airgapped installs ensure values.secrets.kms is unset and provide secret files in values.secrets.filePaths.
changelog_entry: chart(private): compact init lifecycle and add values schema + preflight probe
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the schema surface small to avoid frequent chart churn; model-specific tuning remains in per-tenant overlays.
backcompat: Existing installs will receive a migration warning printed during helm upgrade if they still supply init.oldSequence; automatic migration helper logs a diff but requires operator confirmation.
audits: Added a small audit hook that logs preflight outcomes to the tenant PVC under /var/log/private-installer/preflight/<timestamp>.log for debugging; sensitive outputs redact KMS tokens.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes are limited to ordering and validation; however, improper migration of custom hooks could cause transient failures. Canary rollout recommended.
qa_summary: Integration smoke runs across VPC/airgap topologies completed. Unit tests for schema validation added. Manual verification of idempotency for init jobs performed on staging cluster.
post_merge_tasks: (1) Publish new chart bundle to internal registry; (2) trigger terraform module test matrix with new values examples; (3) notify SRE-runbook authors to update migration section.
internal_links: Linear: ENG-1289, ENG-1304; Docs PR will follow in redwood-docs repository
